exclusion_detail: The lead (optimised conjugate 22) is a dicyanocobinamide (cobalt corrin complex) conjugate of the 39-residue peptide exendin-4: a peptide plus a metal complex, made by solid-phase peptide synthesis and conjugation.

lead.why: Abstract: 'An optimized conjugate (22), comparable with Ex4, was successfully screened and subsequently assayed for insulin secretion in rat islets and in vivo in shrews.'

notes: Peptide and metal-complex conjugates throughout; no small-molecule organic target.
